title: Food estimate cache entry
description: One per-100 g nutrition record in the estimate cache (estCache). Web app storage: localStorage goa:estcache and db doc state/estcache as {map:{<key>: Entry}}. The key is 'v2:' + canonName(description): lowercase, quantities and units removed, a trailing 'from <place>' removed, digits and punctuation removed, neutral words (boneless, cooked, homemade, large, ...) removed, remaining words sorted and joined by single spaces, e.g. 'v2:chicken grilled tikka'. Cooking methods are kept. Dish descriptions with listed ingredients (isDish) are never cached. Written by estimate() after a Claude reply, by rememberFood() when the person corrects a row (by='you'), and by logLabelFood() for nutrition labels (by='you').

name.description: Clean food name without a weight, used to build row labels.

serving_g.description: Grams of one piece (counted foods) or one typical serving. A description with a count and no grams is priced as count × serving_g.

unitOnly.description: Set by rememberFood when the corrected description had no weight: the record is per one piece and labels show '(n)' instead of '(n × g)'. In that case serving_g is 100 and per100 holds one piece's values (100 g is a stand-in).

by.description: Present and 'you' when the numbers came from the person (correction or label). Absent for Claude estimates. A 'you' record makes reused rows log with src='you'.

per100.description: Values per 100 g of cooked, ready-to-eat food (per 100 ml for drinks).

cacheKey.description: Map key shape. Only lowercase letters and spaces follow the prefix. The key can be just 'v2:' when every word was stripped (estimate() does not guard against this).
